configure_database_backend: create a DatabaseConfig to set the storage backend to sqlite, postgres, or memory mode
set_sqlite_directory: create a DatabaseConfig with a custom sqlite_dir to store the deerflow.db file in a specific path
get_sqlalchemy_url: use the app_sqlalchemy_url property to get an async SQLAlchemy connection URL for the current backend
configure_postgres_connection: create a DatabaseConfig with backend postgres and a postgres_url to connect to a PostgreSQL database
resolve_sqlite_path: use the sqlite_path property to get the absolute path of the unified deerflow.db SQLite file
